content_sections.heading: RCF Management Trainee Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates undergo a one-year training period and are paid a lump sum stipend of ₹60,000 per month during this period. Free hostel accommodation on a sharing basis is provided at Trombay/Thal, along with medical facility at the RCF Hospital. On successful completion of training, trainees are absorbed in the E1 Grade with a pay scale of ₹40,000–₹140,000. The minimum total monthly gross emoluments (Basic Pay + VDA at 51.80% + Perks at 34% + HRA at 30% and other allowances) work out to approximately ₹86,320. Management Trainees posted outside Trombay and Thal (such as at Marketing Area Offices) additionally receive a fixed allowance of ₹5,000 per month towards boarding, lodging, and local travel, plus TA/DA on tours. A bond amount of ₹2 lakh must be deposited by the Management Trainee at the time of joining as a fixed deposit with lien marked to RCF Ltd, for a period of 4 years including the one-year training period. On absorption, employees also become eligible for company accommodation (subject to availability), Performance Related Pay, free medical facility for self and dependents, gratuity, contributory provident fund, accident insurance, and pension scheme as per company rules.

content_sections.heading: RCF Management Trainee Selection Process
content_sections.text: The RCF Management Trainee Selection Process consists of an Online Test followed by a Personal Interview. Computer-based objective test of 90 minutes, with 100 questions in total. 50 questions (2 marks each) are from the course curriculum of the relevant discipline/qualifying degree. 50 questions (1 mark each) cover General English, Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning, and General Knowledge/Awareness. There is negative marking for wrong answers. The test is conducted in Hindi (Rajbhasha) and English, at centres in Bhopal, Delhi/Delhi NCR, Lucknow, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Guwahati, Kolkata, Mumbai/Navi Mumbai/Thane/MMR region, and Nagpur. Based on online test performance and document verification, eligible candidates are provisionally called for interview in a ratio of approximately 1:7 (7 candidates per post). Candidates must score a minimum average of 50% in the interview to qualify. Outstation candidates are reimbursed III-tier AC train/bus fare for both the online test and interview, as per the terms in the notification. Separate category-wise and discipline-wise merit lists are prepared. Candidates with nil or negative marks in the online test are not eligible for interview. Final selection is also subject to a pre-employment medical examination and document verification.

content_sections.heading: RCF Management Trainee Required Documents
content_sections.text: Recent passport-size colour photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm) as per specified scan requirements Signature scanned on white paper with black ink Left thumb impression on white paper with black or blue ink Handwritten declaration (in the candidate's own handwriting, in English) as per the format given in the notification Valid photo identity proof (PAN Card, Passport, Driving Licence, Voter's Card, Aadhaar, etc. - Ration Card and Learner's Licence are not accepted) Caste certificate in the prescribed proforma, where applicable (SC/ST/OBC-NCL) Income and Asset Certificate for EWS candidates, issued on or after 1 April 2025 Disability certificate for PwBD candidates, as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules, 2017 No Objection Certificate (NOC), for candidates currently employed in Government/PSU/Autonomous Bodies Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets relevant to the applied discipline

faq.question: Q1. What is RCF Management Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited (RCF Ltd), a Navratna Government of India company, to fill 94 Management Trainee posts across 14 disciplines including Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical, Finance, and Marketing, under Advertisement No. 16022026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in RCF Management Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 94 vacancies (tentative) are notified across 14 disciplines, with Chemical (32 posts), Finance (10 posts), and Marketing (10 posts) carrying the largest share.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for RCF Management Trainee 2026?
faq.answer: The online application window closes on 10 September 2026 at 5:00 pm. Registration opened on 8 August 2026 at 8:00 am.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for RCF Management Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by discipline — typically a relevant BE/B.Tech degree from a UGC/AICTE-recognised institution, though some posts (Finance, Marketing, Rajbhasha, CC Lab) require a postgraduate degree, CA/CMA, or Ph.D. See the Eligibility section above for discipline-wise details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for RCF Management Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: As on 01.02.2026, the general age limit is 27 years for UR/EWS, 30 years for OBC (NCL), and 32 years for SC/ST, with additional relaxation for PwBD candidates and for children/family members of 1984 riot victims. Exact limits vary slightly by post — see the Age Limit section above.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for RCF Management Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ₹1,000 plus bank charges and GST for General, OBC (NCL), and EWS candidates. SC, ST, Ex-Servicemen, PwBD, and female candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for RCF Management Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Visit www.rcfltd.com, click "Apply Online", complete the registration form, upload the required scanned documents, pay the application fee if applicable, and submit the form before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for RCF Management Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on an Online Test (80% weightage) followed by a Personal Interview (20% weightage), subject to document verification and a pre-employment medical examination.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for RCF Management Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selected candidates receive a stipend of ₹60,000 per month during the one-year training period. After successful training, they are absorbed in the E1 Grade (pay scale ₹40,000–₹140,000), with approximate gross monthly emoluments of ₹86,320.

faq.question: Q10. Is there a service bond for RCF Management Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Selected candidates must deposit a bond amount of ₹2 lakh as a fixed deposit with lien marked to RCF Ltd, for a period of 4 years including the one-year training period.
